label: Django + PostgreSQL
summary: Preset: a Django application with its own PostgreSQL database; /admin is internal only.
guide: Your content is a git branch or an uploaded package. It is inspected, then goes live within about 2 minutes.
If a new release fails inspection or does not answer, the last good release stays live.
The app listens on 127.0.0.1:3000 behind Caddy: set options.start (default gunicorn app:app); gunicorn is bound to $PORT for you.
Nothing is built on the server: ship everything the app needs in the release. Put dependencies in vendor/ (pip install --target vendor); it is on PYTHONPATH.
PostgreSQL runs on this container on loopback. os.environ has DB_HOST (127.0.0.1), DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD and DATABASE_URL.
Load your schema yourself: ask an administrator, or create the tables from your app on first start.
/admin/* is only reachable from your own networks.
Files your app writes (uploads) must go in folders listed in options.dataDirs: kept across releases and backed up. Every push replaces the release itself.
